problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign shipments to identical cargo planes. Shipments:

* Shipment Alpha: size 47 cubic meters
* Shipment Beta: size 39 cubic meters
* Shipment Gamma: size 61 cubic meters
* Shipment Delta: size 43 cubic meters
* Shipment Epsilon: size 44 cubic meters
* Shipment Zeta: size 51 cubic meters
* Shipment Eta: size 35 cubic meters
* Shipment Theta: size 36 cubic meters
* Shipment Iota: size 46 cubic meters
* Shipment Kappa: size 61 cubic meters
* Shipment Lambda: size 59 cubic meters
* Shipment Mu: size 49 cubic meters
* Shipment Nu: size 56 cubic meters
* Shipment Xi: size 53 cubic meters
* Shipment Omicron: size 67 cubic meters
* Shipment Pi: size 64 cubic meters
* Shipment Rho: size 41 cubic meters
* Shipment Sigma: size 35 cubic meters
* Shipment Tau: size 37 cubic meters
* Shipment Upsilon: size 38 cubic meters
* Shipment Phi: size 55 cubic meters
* Shipment Chi: size 47 cubic meters
* Shipment Psi: size 35 cubic meters
* Shipment Omega: size 64 cubic meters
* Shipment Arrow: size 67 cubic meters
* Shipment Box: size 48 cubic meters
* Shipment Star: size 63 cubic meters
* Shipment Circle: size 40 cubic meters
* Shipment Triangle: size 60 cubic meters
* Shipment Diamond: size 56 cubic meters
* Shipment Square: size 45 cubic meters
* Shipment Heart: size 53 cubic meters
* Shipment Cross: size 47 cubic meters
* Shipment Moon: size 47 cubic meters
* Shipment Sun: size 51 cubic meters
* Shipment Cloud: size 41 cubic meters
* Shipment Lightning: size 46 cubic meters
* Shipment Rain: size 43 cubic meters
* Shipment Snow: size 36 cubic meters
* Shipment Wind: size 48 cubic meters

Each cargo plane has a maximum capacity of 100 cubic meters. Assign all shipments using the fewest planes possible. Every shipment must be loaded onto exactly one plane, and the total volume in any plane cannot exceed its capacity limit.
